subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid `x-openclaw-agent-id` make OpenAI-compatible HTTP handlers tolerate a generic OpenAI body `model`, despite the current documented agent-first model contract?
rationale: The mechanical code change is narrow, but it changes public API semantics for model selection and needs a parity decision across Chat Completions, Responses, and possibly embeddings.

options.title: Adopt Header Precedence Consistently
options.body: Treat a valid agent header as the selected agent and accept generic body models as client compatibility metadata, with docs and tests for the chosen endpoint set.

options.title: Preserve Agent-First Model Contract
options.body: Keep requiring body `model` values such as `openclaw`, `openclaw/default`, or `openclaw/<agentId>` and document SDK integrations to send those values.

options.title: Allow Chat-Only Compatibility
options.body: Change only `/v1/chat/completions`, accepting a smaller immediate fix while intentionally allowing endpoint semantics to diverge.

recommendation.title: Adopt Header Precedence Consistently
recommendation.body: Treat a valid agent header as the selected agent and accept generic body models as client compatibility metadata, with docs and tests for the chosen endpoint set.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc introduced the agent-first OpenAI-compatible behavior and merged the endpoint expansion that shares this validation path.
